description: On-chain resolutions of MANY Polymarket markets in one call, oldest resolution first, paged: the list form of polymarket_settlement (same row fields), for 'which markets resolved in this window', 'every settled BTC 5-minute market' or a backtest set. `from_ms` is inclusive and `to_ms` exclusive (epoch ms, on resolution time); `slug_prefix` (lowercase letters, digits and `-`, e.g. `btc-updown-5m-`) keeps one family of markets. Returns {settlements, has_more, next_cursor}; while has_more is true pass next_cursor back as `cursor` for the next page. Only markets the chain resolved appear: a cancelled or voided market with no on-chain resolution is not here. Pages are rebuilt every 5 minutes, so a market that resolved in the last 5 minutes may not be listed yet; polymarket_settlement is always current.

from_ms.description: Resolution time, epoch ms, inclusive. Omit for the first resolution.

slug_prefix.description: Only markets whose slug starts with this, e.g. `btc-updown-5m-`.

to_ms.description: Resolution time, epoch ms, exclusive; must be greater than from_ms. Omit for no upper bound.

name: polymarket_settlements_bulk
title: Polymarket Settlements Bulk
